prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Praseodymium (프라세오디뮴) itself — the sovereign of the Praseodymium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a cheerful, sunny openness; light warm-beige skin with a golden undertone; round face; large eyes — large round eyes, outer eye corners slightly lifted; soft feathered brows; petite straight nose; a wide mouth with softly upturned corners; jade-green eyes; a dusting of freckles across nose and cheeks.
Body and hair: petite and compact yet curvaceous — full bust and rounded hips on a small frame build; a braided crown with the rest flowing long with short baby bangs; fresh leek-green hair whose ends fade into a clean bright yellow.
Expression: a bright open laugh, eyes open and engaged.
Her element, carried in her design: praseodymium: a soft silvery metal that grows a green crust in air, split away in 1885 from didymium, an earth long thought to be one element and named for twins, and named from the Greek for leek-green twin because its salts are a fresh leek green while its sister neodymium's are lilac; it tints glass and enamel yellow-green and ceramic glazes a clean bright yellow, and mixed back with neodymium in goggle glass it filters the stinging yellow flare for welders and glassblowers.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — FANTASY
Costume: a high-fantasy royal or warrior costume — plate pauldrons or a gorget, mail or scale over a long tabard or robe, a circlet or crown, a flowing cape; metal ornament and regalia built from the traits above, subtle magical glow along the patterns.
Silhouette: thin leaf-patterned armor plates and flowing light fabric panels with a slender circlet — a slender, graceful silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Colours: fresh leek green, clean praseodymium yellow, twin-sister lilac hint, arc-flare white.
Exposure (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare shoulders and arms between pauldron and bracer, a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, a high slit in the tabard or robe showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; no corset; keep the costume above, material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: a leek-green meadow kingdom of the younger twin: twin mountain peaks split apart by a deep chasm, the near one green and the far one faintly lilac, endless meadows of tall leeks crowned with round pale flower heads, hill villages roofed in yellow-green and bright yellow glazed tiles.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Pr) and atomic number (59) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish, corset, bustle, Victorian tailoring, modern material, machinery.
